title: Broncos will have a pre-draft top-30 visit with Vanderbilt TE Eli Stowers

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Broncos will have a pre-draft top-30 visit with Vanderbilt TE Eli Stowers
sources.description: Vanderbilt tight end Eli Stowers appeared on The Rich Eisen Show on Tuesday and revealed that he has a top-30 pre-draft visit with the Denver Broncos. The team had a formal interview with him at the NFL Scouting Combine, but now, they will have the athletic tight end in for a visit before the draft. […]
